# Clause– Provisions For Ambushes An ambush is any attack which skips key steps in escalation to immediately initiate combat. For most situations, ambushes are strictly forbidden.
You are however allowed to make ambushes if: - You are an antagonist, and you have either an objective targeting a character or explicit admin approval to ambush them. - You are a non-humanoid hostile such as a slime, a space dragon, or an entropic colossus. - You have authorization from Central Command to engage, or you are a full or deputized member of Security acting out a KOS order.
[bold]You may not ambush individuals unrelated to what has been explicitly listed[/bold].
Even when permitted, you should consider whether the simplicity of an ambush is worth losing out on the roleplay of standard escalation for. [bold]You may not intentionally ambush someone who is currently typing, and you may not ambush SSD players.[/bold]
